Who wants mediocre Italian in Vietnam?
Jan 2024 • Friends
Yuk. Mediocre Italian food. Who travels to Vietnam with its vibrant exciting food scene and then has dinner at an Italian restaurant. I was with an Odyssey Unlimited tour of 20 people and this is where the chose to have a dinner. The salad was nice but it was followed by tepid bland minestrone soup and a mushy fish in a parmesan (allegedly) cream sauce. Ice cream for dessert…can’t mess up ice cream so that was good. Setting was lovely and service was good. If the latter matters more to you go for it. If food matters don’t bother. I’ll definitely let Odyssey know we didn’t enjoy this meal in comment card.

Exceptional service! and beautiful decor/ambience
Oct 2023 • Family
We were a family of 4 (2A + 2C aged 21mo/2mo) that stayed here for our family vacay for a week

Breakfast:
This Italian restaurant doubles up as the breakfast area in the mornings, and served a wide selection of breakfast options, including local Vietnamese food (like pho soup & bahn mi), International/Western food, and interestingly Korean food (appears that Danang and the resort is very popular with Korean tourists). The food options also catered for young children, with pancake and choc fondue stations setup to wow the kids. We had breakfast here on 2 mornings, and enjoyed our time there. We were fortunate to beat the breakfast crowd (long queues) here on 2 of the 3 mornings, testament to their popularity.

Dinner:
In the evenings, the dinner queue to this place is equivalently long. We came early (at about 530pm, before the 6pm opening hours), and was hospitably greeted by their lead service staff Mr Dung Nguyen. Though he and the staff were busy preparing the place ahead of the crowd, Mr Dung was extremely considerate and offered to sit our young family at a cozy table while we wait for the chefs to be ready with the first order; this allowed my wife and young 2mo baby to nurse in peace, while my young daughter was able to walk around the beautiful grounds. Mr Dung also initiated our drinks service first, allowing us to wait comfortably before the food was ready. The meal was great, and they were able to prepare the kid's meal first, allowing the anxious parents to a unhurried and enjoyable dinner. The place was even more beautiful at night, complete with warm lighting both within and outside the restaurant, lots of greenery (think resort-like feels), and both an indoor and outdoor sitting. There's also a great bar on the 2nd level right above the restaurant, for waiting guests. Saw another 2 families that participated in a kid's pizza making session before their meal. Was also informed by Mr Dung that they were having live music on some nights. Would definitely come back again.

(PS - big shoutout to the lead service staff Mr Dung Nguyen from the restaurant for his exceptional service; most tourists/visitors/diners would not typically remember the food, but would most definitely remember the experience and how they were treated. Mr Dung's initiative and hospitality is definitely very commendable, and our family is thankful for his efforts in hosting us that night and subsequent morning. To the manager/owner reading this, pls kindly help us convey our thanks to him. Cheers)
